title: Roll Customer 360 to a fresh privacy-aware generation
objective: Continue Repository Step 15 with a bounded Customer 360 generation rollover. Move the shared production projection identity from customer.customer-360.v1 to customer.customer-360.v2 while keeping document schema version 1 unchanged. Prove that a legacy v1 checkpoint and stale personal document do not suppress historical Party privacy events: the normal Customer 360 run_batch path used by the production background worker starts the fresh v2 generation from immutable history, materializes the privacy-minimized tombstone, and leaves legacy v1 evidence untouched but non-authoritative. Query composition must follow the shared v2 constant automatically. This packet does not claim real crm-api process-host no-orphan closure or completion of Repository Step 15.
